verdict.rationale: Vestd documents digital cap table management as 'one source of truth, reconciled'. It covers share classes and share pools, share certificates, and option grants under EMI, CSOP and unapproved schemes. Share issues update Companies House automatically, and cap tables can be shared with chosen stakeholders through data rooms. Missing for 10: any evidence of SAFE (or equivalent convertible instrument) tracking, explicit auditor-facing reporting or access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
